ref_date_note: PCE day (Fri before Labor Day). U (Sep) contract, no roll mention. Closing spike bases ES 6520.5 / NQ 23800. 'Today's high' (8/28) not given numerically -> RTH_HIGH in nq2/nq3 targets; ES 'today's low' -> RTH_LOW in es5. Letter typo: 'short if 6486-6488 becomes resistance but know that this must find traction down through 6483-6486 or it was just a trap (and the long setup above)' read as 6496-6498 (6486-6488 is not a level anywhere, sits 2 pts from 83-86, and the commentary says 'Trapped below 6496-6498 ... likely liquidates to 6483-6486'; the 'long setup above' is the 6494-6502.5 long) - es5 gated 6496-6498, quote kept verbatim. es2 ('I personally probably won't try to long 6508.75, but it is reasonable to consider') included ungraded; the B/B+ belongs to es3 (failure of sellers through 6494-6502.5). es4 true gap up holding 6520-6524 has no stated target and no higher level -> tgt [] (validator 'no targets' warning is genuine). 'targeting roughly 742-752' -> [23742,23752]. He considered 742-762 instead of 752-769; both kept as zones. YM skipped.

trades.name: Failure to sustain above 23800-23804
trades.quote: Shorting a failure to sustain above 800-804 is fine, targeting roughly 742-752. I’ll rate this a B. It would usually be lower but the failed spike and volume into the highs was a pretty terrible look from buyers. Perhaps after the have liquidated the dip would get bought.

trades.name: Hold of 23700-23724
trades.quote: Longing a hold of the 700-724 range is fine and I would make sure that 752 doesn’t prove resistance which it may. Back above 752 after a hold of 700-724 opens a retest of today’s high so there is enough reward for me to rate it a B/B+
trades.stop_hint: I would make sure that 752 doesn’t prove resistance which it may.

trades.name: Hold/LBAF of 23677-23683
trades.quote: I’m “okay” looking for longs on a hold or LBAF of 677-683 but keep in the back of mind the potential for an intermediate time frame bearish setup being in play. I would broadly target 742-752, mindful of the 700-724 range. A reclaim and hold of 752 (and certainly 769) opens a retest of today’s high. I’ll rate this a B- as it carries perhaps slightly lower probability.

trades.name: Failure to sustain above 6520-6524
trades.quote: Like for NQ, shorting a failure to sustain above 6520-6524 is reasonable. It targets 6513-6514 with runners for continuation. This is rated far lower on ES due to limited range and the fact that it is so much stronger than NQ. C+/B-

trades.name: Long 6508.75
trades.quote: I personally probably won’t try to long 6508.75, but it is reasonable to consider.

trades.name: Sellers fail to get through 6494-6502.5
trades.quote: I will, however, monitor for any failure from sellers to get through 6494-6502.5 and look for a long. This is a wide range, but until/unless sellers find traction below there, there is no meaningful short in play. B/B+ as it is not well-defined, but bulls are currently in full control

trades.name: True gap up holding 6520-6524
trades.quote: A true gap up that holds 6520-6524 is a long. ES has been an extremely slow grind, so I don’t love this long much personally, but it is definitely a long. I’ll rate it a B-.
trades.stop_hint: If we open on a true gap up, then the 6513-6514 spot becomes more important to hold.

trades.name: 6496-6498 becomes resistance (letter: 6486-6488)
trades.quote: I may actually consider a short if 6486-6488 becomes resistance but know that this must find traction down through 6483-6486 or it was just a trap (and the long setup above). C+/B-
trades.stop_hint: this must find traction down through 6483-6486 or it was just a trap (and the long setup above).
